issues.description: All 33 frozen read dependencies are dispositioned. Full closure remains unresolved because local raw candidates lack complete field/identifier/history proof, hand-collected SEC-derived rows are not supplied, several distinct prepared panels remain without in-source producers, and stacked_data.csv needs a validated persistence step from the existing in-memory cohort object before its first workspace reset at line 2631.

The bounded catalog results identify candidate CRSP, Compustat, segment, IBES and FRB products, but no successful exact-field probe established complete consumed-field mappings or row/history coverage. Candidate table presence is not treated as compatible raw availability.

The supplied R source reads overall_sample.csv, unmatched_sample_with_lags.csv, data_with_debt_issuance.csv, unmatched_sample_used_in_determinants.csv and overall_sample_longer_panel_october_2023.csv without a preceding writer in the supplied source. These author-named files have distinct panels/keys and cannot be collapsed into generic extract identity or ordinary preparation. The separate unmatched_sample1 input has an explicitly identified in-memory source object and a concrete save-before-reset proposal.

The datasheet states the 11,000-row quarterly hedge-position compilation is proprietary while providing Appendix A guidance. SEC filings are public, but firm-period population, manual category values, adoption and UGL fields are not packaged, so reconstructing the documented collection remains a real data task.

The IBES join requires scored, effective-dated TICKER-to-PERMNO links with SCORE=1 and unique ticker selection. The bounded exact ICLINK lookup found no matching leaf, and no compatible local link product or period alignment was established.

The source builds the in-memory stacked cohort at line 2574, then clears the workspace at the first reset at line 2631. The full intervening source block through the later reset at line 2689 contains no stacked reassignment, so the previous proposed write before line 2689 would use an object already removed. The event-study consumer reads ./stacked_data.csv at line 2709 and derives year_treated from gvkey, asu and fyear before joining the determinants sample by gvkey. A conditional save of the existing stacked object immediately before the first reset is supported; output row order, timing keys and repeated consumers still require validation.
The R runtime is registered, but availability of the 17 library dependencies called by the core and appendix source has not been verified.

evidence.description: The datasheet describes quarterly SEC/EDGAR derivative disclosures, their measured content and manual collection period.
evidence.quote:
•   Detailed derivative disclosures (fair values, accounting gains-and-losses, hedge
       accounting type classifications, hedged risks, hedging instruments, hedged
       currencies/commodities, notional values, ASU 2017-12 adoption dates, ASU 2017-12’s
       prescribed elements, and qualitative risk management discussions) were obtained from
       quarterly SEC filings per EDGAR. Ali closely supervised this process, with additional
       oversight by Bens and Cassar. The data were manually collected from July 2021
       through January 2024. Please refer to Appendix A for detailed steps for hand-collecting
       the data.

evidence.description: The authors describe their hand-collected quarterly hedge-position data as proprietary and provide Appendix A collection guidance.
evidence.quote:
We hand-collected novel derivative disclosures dataset over 2.5 years by applying technical
hedge accounting expertise and training more than 15 RAs to compile over 11,000 raw
quarterly hedge positions. We consider the compilation of this unique data proprietary and
intend to utilize it for follow-up projects. Therefore, we do not wish to share the manual and
electronic coding of the raw hand-collected data before it is merged with the standard WRDS
databases. We provide detailed step-by-step guidance in Appendix A below to enable
researchers to compile the equivalent of the same data on their own.

evidence.description: The datasheet describes the R code as table-wise and supplies a code-to-paper variable map.
evidence.quote:
The R-Studio code is divided into table-wise sections of the paper. Appendix B of this datasheet
is a helper table that maps the variable names used in the paper to the variable names in the
code.
